title: Remote Work Policy (Amendment)
content: Effective from April 15, 2026, employees of Acme Corp are permitted to work remotely up to three days per week. This amendment supersedes all prior remote work policies. The change reflects updated collaboration requirements. Employees must be present in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays at minimum. Core hours remain 10:00 to 16:00 local time. Equipment provisions remain unchanged. Approval for co-working spaces remains subject to manager discretion. This updated policy was approved by the Executive Leadership Team.
